channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kaleb Canales | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kaleb Canales from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Kaleb Canales
item.description:
Joe Freeman:Matthews on #Blazers coaching search:

“I think I speak on behalf of the team when I say that we all feel Kaleb (Canales) is the one for us.”

Wesley Matthews on Kaleb Canales, Jul 13, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Chad Buchanan, Kaleb Canales
item.description:
Blazers GM Neil Olshey on Chad Buchanan and Kaleb Canales:

“If Chad [Buchanan] wants to be part of the future of the franchise, that's something I'm open to... He's someone I think highly of.”

Neil Olshey on Chad Buchanan, Kaleb Canales, Jun 5, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Larry Miller on Kaleb Canales
item.description:
Blazers president Larry Miller on future of interim coach Kaleb Canales:

“I have had a number of [players] tell me directly they support him. That definitely will be taken into consideration. Our goal is to put ourselves in the best position to win, not just to win games, but to win a championship. We're going to look at that and that will be a major factor as we go through this. Kaleb has a lot of support, not just from the players but from the organization.”

Larry Miller on Kaleb Canales, Apr 18, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Luke Babbitt on Nate McMillan, Kaleb Canales
item.description:
Luke Babbitt on whether Kaleb Canales is more player-friendly than Nate McMillan:

“I want to be careful with how I say that but they definitely have different styles. I'll just say that everyone likes Kaleb. He's a guy that has everyone's respect. We're trying to play hard for him. That's about it.”

Luke Babbitt on Nate McMillan, Kaleb Canales, Mar 30, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Kaleb Canales
item.description:
Chris Haynes:LaMarcus Aldridge on Canales' sets:

“I got the ball in so many different spots, they couldn't double team me... I felt like we had so many options tonight we had so many guys playing well taking good shots that they couldn't stop us tonight.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Kaleb Canales, Mar 17, 2012. Source: Twitter.
